youtube.title: What if you were a Victorian sewer hunter for one day?
youtube.description:
London, 1850: you climb into the sewers at low tide to hunt for coins, bones and copper – and in six hours the Thames floods the tunnels. 🐀🌊 Victorian toshers made about six shillings a day.
Would you take this job? A) Yes, 6 shillings! B) Only with a big gang C) Never. Rats. – Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: Henry Mayhew, London Labour and the London Poor, Vol. 2 (1851); Smithsonian Magazine, "Quite Likely the Worst Job Ever" (2012); Mike Dash, "The Worst Job There Has Ever Been" (2012)
